name: Bauernhof-Ferienwohnung Bichlhof
beschreibung: The Bichlhof farm holiday apartment is located in Thiersee in the district of Kufstein and offers holiday apartments in an agricultural setting. The accommodation is suitable for self-caterers who appreciate the tranquillity of the region. The adjoining farm keeps animals that guests can help look after. The well-equipped apartments have separate sleeping and living areas. Thiersee lies in the border region with Deutschland and is known for the Thiersee with its swimming lake. From here, excursions into the surrounding mountains as well as to Kufstein and into the Bavarian Inntal are possible.
